output.summary: Black henbane is a poisonous plant native to temperate Europe and Siberia. Its foliage and seeds contain psychoactive chemicals, and ingestion can cause hallucinations, delirium, coma or death; historically, it was used to flavour beer before hops replaced it between the 11th and 16th centuries.
output.edibilityNote: Historically, henbane was used to flavour beer, but it fell from use when hops replaced it between the 11th and 16th centuries.
